tasks.description: Write an end-to-end pipeline smoke test for the whisper→qwen3→signal chain. Create ~/Documents/Voxight/scripts/test-pipeline.js that: (1) calls whisperLocal.js transcribeAudio() with a short test audio file (use any existing .mp3/.wav in the repo or download a 10-second clip), (2) passes the transcript to qwen3Insights.js extractInsights(), (3) calls oracleSignals.js createSignal() to create a test signal, (4) immediately queries it back via querySignals(), (5) logs each step result and any errors to console and writes a summary to ~/Documents/Voxight/logs/pipeline-test-YYYY-MM-DD.json. If Ollama is not running locally, the test should gracefully skip Qwen3 steps and log 'LOCAL_UNAVAILABLE'. Add 'test-pipeline': 'node scripts/test-pipeline.js' to package.json scripts.
